programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: Peak Performance
programme.desc: The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World, but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.

programme.title: The Anomaly
programme.desc: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

programme.title: The Digiverse And Beyond, The Elemental Masters
programme.desc: Tackling a puzzle about technology in Ninjago. A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. programme.title: Christmas Child
programme.desc: As Jack delves into the mysteries surrounding the nativity and its creator, he uncovers secrets from his past, reunites with the family he never knew.

programme.title: Christmas Magic
programme.desc: After a car accident, a woman awakens in Central Park with an angel, who gives her a chance to earn entrance to heaven. The film is a story of discovery and the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: (2019) Thriller with Samaire Armstrong. A teenage girl returns home years after disappearing, but joy is short lived when suspicious character start following her every move.

programme.title: Off The Rails
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller starring Hannah Barefoot. After surviving a train wreck, a married woman loses her memory. As the pieces of her old life start to come together, will the truth tear her apart?

programme.title: Killer Ending
programme.desc: (2018) Drama thriller starring Chelsea Hobbs. Crime fiction becomes a horrifying reality when a novelist's daughter is abducted in a copycat scenario taken straight from her latest book.

programme.title: Gone Daughter Gone
programme.desc: (2020) Suspenseful thriller starring Andrea Bogart. When her daughter is abducted, Shannon decides to take matters into her own hands, putting her on a collision course with a deadly kidnapper...

programme.title: Summer House
programme.desc: (2008) Mystery-thriller starring Lindsay Price. A woman inherits a family summer house haunted by a centuries-old curse, leading to a series of strange events that threaten her life.

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: Mary and The Witch's Flower
programme.desc: Young Mary follows a mysterious cat into the nearby forest and discovers an old broomstick and the strange Fly-by-Night flower, a rare plant that blossoms once every seven years. Together, the flower and the broomstick whisk Mary above the clouds, and far away to Endor College, a school of magic...

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: "Match Point" is a drama about ambition, the seduction of wealth, love, and sexual passion. Perhaps most importantly, however, the story reveals the huge part luck plays in events, refuting the comforting misconception that more of life is under our control than really is.

programme.title: A Puppy for Christmas
programme.desc: After adopting a cute puppy, Noelle's world is turned upside down when her boyfriend breaks up with her. After accepting an invitation to spend the holidays with a co-worker, she is surrounded by the Christmas cheer of a happy family and soon sparks begin to fly.

programme.title: Candid about Love
programme.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer's Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn't taken a new photo in ten years, she's determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.

programme.title: The Boy in the Plastic Bubble
programme.desc: The girl next door makes a teen born with immune deficiencies want to leave his germ-free bubble.

programme.title: A Star is Born (1937)
programme.desc: Young Esther Victoria Blodgett arrives in Hollywood with big dreams of becoming a star. She manages to make it big with help from Norman Maine, a leading actor battling alcoholism, whose glory days are fading. This film contains language and attitudes of its time, that some viewers may find offensive.

programme.title: Over the Top
programme.desc: A Championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted.

programme.title: Coming Through the Rye
programme.desc: In 1969, the Holden Caulfield-obsessed Jamie Schwartz runs away from boarding school to find the reclusive author J.D. Salinger. Inspired by actual events, Jamie's search becomes a journey of sexual awakening, love and loss.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: When a wisecracking black hustler from South Central L.A. finds himself transported back to medieval England, he leads the overthrow of an evil king and wins the heart of a proto feminist woman.

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, high school basketball coach Al Collins assembles students from five different Louisiana schools and leads them all the way to the state championships.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: A journalist, cameraman and war correspondent embark on a mission to find the No.1 war criminal in Bosnia.

programme.title: The Family
programme.desc: A notorious Mafia clan is relocated to Normandy, where fitting in soon becomes challenging.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: An art curator decides to seek revenge on his abusive boss by conning him into buying a fake Monet.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: To pay for his daughter's surgery, a card dealer teams up with a co-worker to pull off a casino heist.

programme.title: The Claus Family
programme.desc: After discovering his grandfather is Santa Claus, Jules has to help him deliver his presents all around the world. But Jules' hatred for Christmas might make that more difficult than Santa thought.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Joseph and Mary
programme.desc: During a time of much civil unrest, a holy man, Rabbi Elijah, swears an oath to protect the two young sons of a persecuted man. But while Jesus survives King Herod's slaughter of the innocents, it tragically claims the lives of the boys Elijah swore to protect.Seeking to avenge their deaths, he begins his quest for retribution. But when he meets Joseph, Mary and their young son Jesus, the anger that fuels his revenge is questioned. Elijah is faced with a life-changing choice: should he kill, or should he choose forgiveness, and in doing so, contradict every scripture upheld by his forefathers? With a powerful performance from Kevin Sorbo (Hercules, God's Not Dead), Joseph and Mary, is a stirring story of inspiration and hope, and of mercy versus revenge, set in the years before Jesus became the man who ultimately changed the course of humanity forever.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: The night Abigail (Christina Ricci) meets Ben (Hamish Linklater) at a bar, they jokingly come up with a list of things to do before their imagined breakup, knowingly full well theyll never even start a relationship. But when the joke turns in to a one-night stand things become a whole lot more complicated.

programme.title: Reclaim
programme.desc: Starring Ryan Phillippe, Rachelle Lefevre and John Cusack. Steven and Shannon risk their lives to reveal the truth behind their newly adopted daughter's disappearance. They soon discover that all is not what it seems when they uncover a high-stakes underground child trafficking scam, which sends them on a high octane mission of retribution. How far will they go to save their daughter?

programme.title: The Bronx Bull
programme.desc: Based on awe-inspiring true events, this epic 'rags to riches' tale recounts the story of young boxer Jake LaMotta as he struggles to get to the top of his game. Featuring an award-winning cast starring William Forsythe (The Rock), Paul Sorvino (Goodfellas), Tom Sizemore (Saving Private Ryan), Penelope Ann Miller (The Artist), Natasha Henstridge and Ray Wise (RoboCop).

programme.title: The Reef: Stalked
programme.desc: After Nic and Annie witness the horrific murder of their sister, they try to escape the trauma by traveling to a remote Pacific Island for a kayaking adventure. But within hours of arriving, the women are attacked far from land by a great white shark. Bleeding, vulnerable and with their lives at stake, its a fight for survival when they realise that theyre being stalked by the deadly beast.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: In 1940s England, thirteen year old Tolly is sent to Green Knowe, the country estate of his grandmother, while his mother searches for any information concerning his missing in action father. Tolly soon finds that he can pass through time to witness the family stories Grandmother Oldknow tells him.

programme.title: After The Wedding
programme.desc: Isabel (Michelle Williams) has devoted her life to running an orphanage in a Kolkata slum. With funds running dry, she lands uncomfortably in the sights of a possible benefactor, Theresa Young (Julianne Moore), a multi-millionaire media mogul. Theresa's life couldn't appear to be more perfect.

programme.title: Hope Gap
programme.desc: Annette Bening, Bill Nighy and Josh O'Connor shine in William Nicholson's intimate portrait of a family crisis.

programme.title: The Rewrite
programme.desc: Once upon a time, screenwriter Keith Michaels was on top of the world. But now, he's divorced, broke and hasn't written a hit film in years. His attitude slowly begins to turn when he meets Holly, a single mum.

programme.title: Just for the Summer
programme.desc: Teacher Penelope Campbell loves visiting her Grandma Dot every summer – despite her constant attempts to find Penelope a man! This year, she bumps into her childhood sweetheart Jason Humphrey, who explains his grandmother is desperate to pair him off, too.

programme.title: Tailor-Made Romance
programme.desc: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

programme.title: A Week in Paradise
programme.desc: A film star with a newly broken heart jets off to paradise in the Caribbean, where she finds not only herself again, but maybe even a new love.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI

The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.9

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.10
programme.desc: Se Gi declares all-out war against Do Hyun, and Ri Jin is taken aback by his icy demeanor. Chae Yeon is startled when Se Gi suddenly appears before her. programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.11
programme.desc: Tae Im faints in shock after seeing Se Gi on the hospital CCTV in Cha Jun Pyo's room. Ri Jin decides to leave home, and Ri On reluctantly lets her go. Meanwhile, Se Gi demands that Ri Jin choose between him and Do Hyun, but Ri Jin retorts, “Then show me what makes you special.”

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.12
programme.desc: Do Hyun despairs after realizing the things Se Gi has done. Chae Yeon grows even more conflicted over Do Hyun's sudden change in attitude. Ri Jin, like Se Gi once did, struggles to help Do Hyun change for the better, while Tae Im meets Seok Ho Pil.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.13
programme.desc: Ri Jin begins having nightmares, worrying Do Hyun. However, she keeps her distance, prompting Do Hyun to reconsider her relationship with Ri On. Meanwhile, Young Pyo becomes convinced that Min Seo Yeon's child is still alive, and Ri On has his first encounter with Yo Na, one of Do Hyun's personalities.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Lim Heon-il! This artist made his big debut in the music scene after winning the Bronze Award at the 15th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest in 2004. Since then he has actively pursued his career both as a guitarist and vocalist. As a guitarist he has played for a number of Korea's top artists including Kim Dong-ryul Lim Jae-beom and Lee So-ra. He's also been part of many renowned bands such as iamnot Mate Jeong Won-young Band and Band Bremen. Then in 2013 this artist transformed into a solo artist with the album Becoming a Love. Last year Lim Heon-il took part in Begin Again Season 3 and once again showed off his prowess as a guitarist and vocalist. Then in April this year he released his second album Breathe after a break of 7 years. All the songs in the album were composed written and produced by Lim Heon-il himself perfectly quenching listeners' thirst. In this episode Lim Heon-il performs Leave Home and Everything from his new album RBTY and many other songs to delight viewers. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the essence of his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented quintet ONEWE! ONEWE is an alternative rock band composed of YongHoon KangHyun HaRin DongMyeong and CyA. The band's name is a combination of one and and we shine on you which speaks to the members' ambition to shine on everyone and become one in the name of music. With exceptional talents in songwriting and lyric-writing the five young musicians never fail to impress listeners. Not surprisingly the quintet is expanding their audience reach both at home and abroad and their single Q entered the Billboard World Digital Song Sales Chart in April last year. Each member boasts his own distinctive musical talents so their music is versatile and kaleidoscopic yet harmonious. In this episode ONEWE performs Regulus Crazy ONEWE Medley and more to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these talented ambitious five artists!

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Un Natale da scoprire
programme.desc: Un imprevisto matrimonio della vigilia costringe una donna a trascorrere il Natale nella campagna inglese, dove la collaborazione con un uomo del posto si trasforma in qualcosa di più.

programme.title: Tutto merito del Natale
programme.desc: Una brillante pubblicitaria collabora con un dirigente per aiutare un'organizzazione benefica durante le feste e scopre che il lavoro può aprire la strada a qualcosa di molto più personale.

programme.title: Un Natale a Holly Lane
programme.desc: Tre amiche d'infanzia si ritrovano nella casa di Holly Lane dove trascorrevano il Natale da ragazze e devono unire le forze per salvarla.

programme.title: Natale a Happy Hollow
programme.desc: Una sviluppatrice immobiliare scopre che la fattoria di alberi di Natale appena acquistata nasconde complicati legami con la comunità locale e collabora con uno storico per risolvere la situazione.

programme.title: Natale tra i monti Blue Ridge
programme.desc: Una donna torna nella sua città natale per aiutare a organizzare un matrimonio natalizio e si riavvicina a un amore del passato tra le montagne Blue Ridge.

programme.title: Natale con Bob
programme.desc: James e il gatto Bob vivono sereni grazie al successo ricevuto dopo la pubblicazione del libro. Tuttavia, James diventa il bersaglio di un'indagine sulla protezione degli animali, che minaccia di portargli via il suo amato gatto a Natale.

programme.title: Oggi è sempre Natale
programme.desc: Il Natale si avvicina e l'adolescente Eddie spera che un nuovo paio di scarpe da ginnastica come regalo possa aiutarlo a catturare l'attenzione della vicina Cindy. La mattina di Natale l'albero è vuoto e sembra non esserci nemmeno l'ombra di un regalo.

programme.title: Ricordati di te
programme.desc: Tratto dal libro best seller. Darcy Archer è una ragazza romantica, che sogna di essere conquistata dall'uomo perfetto. Invece, un giorno, mentre si reca al lavoro in bicicletta, Darcy si scontra accidentalmente con uno sconosciuto bello e ben vestito che porta a spasso il cane.

programme.title: Una promessa sotto il vischio
programme.desc: Due sconosciuti, delusi dall'amore e allergici al Natale, stringono un patto: fingere di essere una coppia fino alla fine delle feste. Ma tra cene aziendali, luci scintillanti e rami di vischio, quella che era solo una finta relazione inizia a trasformarsi in qualcosa di vero e magico.

programme.title: Bonus Malus
programme.desc: Marco Altoviti, ispettore di una compagnia assicurativa, attraversa la Toscana per verificare sinistri e possibili frodi. Il lavoro lo mette a contatto con un'umanità imprevedibile e con le proprie fragilità, tra ironia, sentimenti e disillusioni.

programme.title: Speriamo che sia femmina
programme.desc: Capolavoro di Monicelli con un cast eccezionale. In un casale della campagna toscana vive in armonia un gruppo di donne. Elena dirige la fattoria, e la domestica Fosca è il vero nume tutelare della casa, che provvede alle necessità di tutte. Fosca si prende cura di sua figlia Immacolata e della nipote di Elena, Martina, figlia di Claudia che, per egoismo, l'ha affidata alla sorella.

programme.title: A ovest di Paperino
programme.desc: Dal mattino alla sera, la giornata di tre giovani, due uomini e una donna, che si incontrano nella Firenze di oggi. Lui lavora in una radio privata, lei è pittrice, il terzo è disoccupato e sta andando a iscriversi all'ufficio di collocamento. Vagando senza una meta precisa, i tre si imbattono in personaggi bizzarri e situazioni surreali, per ritrovarsi, alla fine, con i problemi di sempre.

programme.title: Italian boys
programme.desc: Una sfida fino all'ultima nota musicale in questa commedia cult anni 80 con la regia di Umberto Smaila. Trip Radio e Radio Metropolis, due emittenti separate da un'accesa rivalità, sono impegnate in una gara musicale: vincerà chi saprà conquistare il pubblico femminile. I risultati sono incerti, ma entrambe cercheranno di assicurarsi l'appoggio di cantanti come Ivan Graziani e Andrea Mingardi.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e fanno parte della redazione di un giornale satirico gestito da un cinquantenne dalla battuta pronta e con un passato da sessantottino. Dado ha un grande successo con le donne, mentre Marco da questo punto di vista ha molti problemi, fin quando nella loro vita fanno irruzione Adele e Maria.

programme.title: Souvenir d'Italie
programme.desc: Tre giovani straniere attraversano l'Italia in autostop, dalla Riviera a Venezia, Pisa e Roma. Lungo il viaggio incontrano uomini, occasioni e piccoli imprevisti che trasformano la vacanza in una serie di avventure sentimentali, offrendo un ritratto leggero e romantico dell'Italia degli anni Cinquanta.

programme.title: Intrigo a Taormina
programme.desc: Durante una crociera di lusso verso la Sicilia, gli ospiti del commendator Lemeni intrecciano relazioni, gelosie e tradimenti. Coppie e amanti si scambiano in una catena di equivoci sentimentali tra mare e mondanità.

programme.title: Le motorizzate
programme.desc: Cinque episodi raccontano con ironia il rapporto tra donne, automobili e vita quotidiana nell'Italia del boom economico. Tra suore spericolate, automobiliste, truffe, equivoci e improbabili vigili urbani, una commedia corale che mette in scena vizi e ossessioni dell'Italia su quattro ruote.

programme.title: Riusciranno i nostri eroi a ritrovare l'amico misteriosamente scomparso in Africa?
programme.desc: Divertentissima commedia con il grande Alberto Sordi. Un editore romano, portandosi dietro il suo fido ragioniere, parte per l'Africa alla ricerca di un suo amico misteriosamente scomparso da più di due anni. Dopo varie peripezie i due scoprono che l'amico ha lasciato dietro di sé la civiltà e si è insediato in una tribù d'indigeni dove si è spacciato per un'altra persona.

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Oltre le Colline
programme.desc: Alina torna dalla Germania per prendere Voichita, l'unica persona che abbia mai amato e che mai amerà. Ma Voichita ha incontrato Dio e in amore, è molto difficile avere Dio come rivale.

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: Primavera del 1942. Dopo la partenza del fratello per il fronte, Homer Macauley, 14 anni, è determinato a diventare il più veloce portalettere dell'ufficio del telegrafo così da poter mantenere la sua numerosa famiglia. E così, mentre sull'isola di Ithaca la primavera lascia il posto all'estate, il giovane Homer passa le sue giornata a recapitare messaggi d'amore e di speranza ma anche di dolore e morte, finché anche lui non riceverà un messaggio che gli cambierà la vita per sempre

programme.title: Little sister
programme.desc: Tre sorelle, Sachi, Yoshino e Chika, vivono insieme a Kamakura. Dopo la morte del padre, che non vedevano da 15 anni, vanno al funerale e incontrano la loro sorellastra adolescente. Decidono di invitarla a vivere con loro, avviando un nuovo capitolo della loro vita.

programme.title: NATALE A HAPPY HOLLOW
programme.desc: I piani di una promotrice immobiliare incontrano un ostacolo quando scopre che ci sono molti proprietari di una fattoria di alberi di Natale che ha recentemente acquistato. Per salvare il suo progetto, deve collaborare con uno storico locale per convincere i proprietari a vendere le loro quote di terreno.

programme.title: UN NATALE IN VIGNA
programme.desc: Heather, conduttrice di “Read Between the Vines”, è determinata a creare il perfetto episodio natalizio presentando un'azienda vinicola unica della sua città natale. L'unica cosa che le ostacola il cammino? Rudy, l'affascinante e testardo proprietario dell'azienda vinicola.

programme.title: UN NATALE DA SCOPRIRE
programme.desc: Il Natale nella campagna inglese non era nei piani di Emma fino a quando sua sorella Amy non ha deciso di organizzare il suo matrimonio per la vigilia di Natale. Dylan, il socio di Amy nel mercatino di Natale, collabora con Emma per mettere ordine nel caos dei preparativi.

programme.title: UN NATALE VERO E SINCERO
programme.desc: Un magico desiderio natalizio dona a un organizzatore di eventi la capacità di ascoltare ciò che tutti desiderano per le festività.

programme.title: Il Natale di Belle
programme.desc: È quasi Natale e Belle si trova a dover lasciare la California per un lavoro: la casa d'aste per cui lavora la manda nella villa di un cliente, Hunter Lowell, che sembrerebbe essere tutto fuorché amichevole. Belle lavora sodo: la magione è stupenda, il cliente un po' meno. Quando, però, i due cominciano a spendere più tempo assieme scocca la scintilla. Basterà questo a scaldare il suo cuore di ghiaccio?

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: Nell
programme.desc: Nell è una ragazza che vive insieme alla madre sorda, isolata dal mondo, in un cottage nella foresta. Dopo la morte della madre, viene scoperta da Jerome, il medico locale. È affascinato da lei, dal momento che parla un linguaggio incompresibile.

programme.title: Un Orso Di Nome Winnie
programme.desc: Le origini di Winnie the Pooh. La storia vera di Harry Colebourn, un soldato canadese che, ai tempi della Primo conflitto mondiale, comprò un cucciolo di orso rimasto orfano, lo addomesticò e gli diede il nome della sua città natale: Winnipeg.

programme.title: La signora Dalloway
programme.desc: Clarissa Dalloway, un'attempata signora di Londra, riflette riguardo la propria vita e sulle decisioni prese ingenuamente.

programme.title: L'eroe
programme.desc: Un giornalista ambizioso ma mediocre viene relegato a una redazione di provincia e poi licenziato. Quando il nipote di una potente imprenditrice viene rapito, torna al centro della scena. Tra scoop e paure collettive, il paese cerca un colpevole.

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: Durante una fatidica notte della Seconda Guerra Mondiale, una troupe itinerante di attori mette in scena il “Re Lear” di Shakespeare in un piccolo teatro inglese.

programme.title: Undisputed 4: Il ritorno di Boyka
programme.desc: Yuri Boyka sta portando in alto il suo nome nel mondo dei grandi campionati di combattimento quando una morte accidentale sul ring lo costringe a mettere in discussione tutto ciò che egli rappresenta.

programme.title: Gun Shy: Eroe per caso
programme.desc: Turk Henry, bassista di una band di successo che si è recentemente sciolta, parte con la moglie per una vacanza di lusso esotica in Cile. Quando la donna viene rapita da un gruppo di banditi, Turk è costretto a rimboccarsi le maniche e a inoltrarsi in una pericolosa missione di salvataggio.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Aftershock
programme.desc: Sulla costa cilena, la vacanza del turista americano Gringo, giunto in visita all'amico dopo aver divorziato, volge al meglio quando incontra un gruppo di tre belle turiste con cui andare a divertirsi. Quando però nel corso della notte un violento terremoto colpisce la zona e devasta ogni cosa compreso il nightclub sotterraneo in cui si stanno divertendo, il terrore prende il sopravvento.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.sub-title: La morte ha il tuo profilo
programme.desc: Laura è una delle ragazze più popolari del college: quando la misteriosa Ma Rina le chiede l'amicizia su un social network, Laura accetta. Ben presto, però, Ma Rina diventa ossessiva e Laura decide di rimuoverla dalla lista degli amici. Una scelta dalle tragiche conseguenze.

programme.title: May
programme.desc: Solitaria e ossessionata dalla perfezione, May fatica a costruire legami veri. Quando la realtà la delude, inizia a collezionare... parti. L'amico perfetto, dopotutto, può sempre essere creato. Un horror psicologico disturbante, tenero e inquietante allo stesso tempo.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un uomo che ha perso la vista in un incidente sviluppa superpoteri e diventa un esperto di arti marziali.

programme.title: Nuove radici
programme.desc: La moglie e madre Amish, Annie, affronta una crisi quando suo marito lascia la comunità Amish per vivere tra gli americani normali, o gli inglesi come li chiamano gli Amish. Ma la situazione diventa ancora più grave quando suo marito torna, cercando la custodia del loro figlio ed è disposto a uccidere per raggiungere il suo obiettivo…

programme.title: Two Wrongs
programme.desc: Sarah è una madre costretta a passare troppo tempo lontano dalla propria figlia Lauren per colpa del lavoro. La donna è infatti un'infermiera e svolge la professione a domicilio. Il suo incubo peggiore diventa realtà quando la bambina viene rapita e la giovane fa di tutto pur di poterla riabbracciare.

programme.title: Sono affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Un ex professore offre ad Adam un milione di dollari per ottenere del plasma dal laboratorio di una società di alta tecnologia. Adam chiede aiuto al nonno criminale. Riusciranno a convincere il ora onesto padre di Adam a unirsi?

programme.title: Una pasticceria da amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una pasticcera di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando dei costruttori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio costringendola ad andarsene, dovrà fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua pasticceria.

programme.title: Chiedi alla polvere
programme.desc: A Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore Arturo e la cameriera Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere un romanzo, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti. Diversi per estrazione etnica e culturale, finiranno per innamorarsi in maniera del tutto inaspettata.

programme.title: Le pagine della mia vita
programme.desc: Quando Lisa torna nella sua città natale per cercare ispirazione per la sua nuova linea di moda, si ritrova ad aiutare la sua migliore amica a prepararsi alla nascita del primo figlio.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Basato sulla saga di best seller mondiali scritta dall'americana Lauren Kate, FALLEN ha per protagonista Lucinda “Luce” Price, una diciassettenne dalla forte forza di volontà che apparentemente sembra vivere una vita normale, fino a quando non viene accusata di un crimine che non ha commesso.

programme.title: L'odore della notte
programme.desc: Remo Guerra è un poliziotto dalla doppia vita. Durante la notte è a capo di un gruppo di rapinatori dell'estrema periferia di Roma che commette diverse rapine nelle case dei ricchi.

programme.title: Mancino Naturale
programme.desc: Isabella è vedova da tre anni e vive in un modesto appartamento a Latina con Paolo, il figlio dodicenne, sul quale ha riversato tutte le sue aspettative.

programme.title: Sono affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Vito (Dustin Hoffman) vive con il padre Jessie (Sean Connery) e il figlio Adam (Matthew Broderick). Insieme gestiscono un commercio all'ingrosso di carni.

programme.title: Naufragi
programme.desc: Maria ha una personalità strana, sempre tenera con i figli anche se il marito la vorrebbe meno ingenua. Un evento terribile la getterà in un vortice di disperazione ma l'incontro con Amal, donna fuggita dalla guerra, la aiuterà a ritrovare le priorità della vita.

programme.title: Lovers
programme.desc: Tradimenti, vendette, amori e colpi di scena animano quattro storie parallele interpretate dai medesimi attori sullo sfondo di Bologna. Amore, commedia, dubbio e sospetto si fondono nel film italiano pluripremiato all'estero.

programme.title: Un amore a gonfie vele
programme.desc: Quando Lorelei eredita una barca a vela da un parente, assume Rob per aiutarla a ripararla e farla navigare dalla sua posizione attuale su un'isola dei Caraibi a Miami. I due dovranno lavorare insieme mentre le scintille romantiche iniziano a volare.

programme.title: A Gift for Christmas
programme.desc: Basato sul libro best seller. Darcy è un romantica che si scontra con un affascinante sconosciuto. Svenuto, lascia il suo cucciolo e un misterioso regalo di Natale. Darcy aiuta Aidan a recuperare i suoi ricordi.

programme.title: Il disegno del Natale
programme.desc: Ember Morley, graphic designer e aspirante illustratrice di libri di fiabe a Manhattan, rimane sorpresa quando scopre di aver ereditato la fattoria degli alberi di Natale di sua nonna. Ritorna nella sua città natale, Willow Hill, per venderlo prima di Natale, ma gli affascinanti cittadini la convincono a restare un po' più a lungo e ad aiutarla a pianificare il loro annuale Festival dell'albero di Natale. Quando è costretta a lavorare con Brandon Hart, il bel custode della fattoria, Ember si ricorda delle cose che una volta desiderava nella vita. La magia del Natale la guiderà sulla strada giusta?

programme.title: Sempre nel mio cuore
programme.desc: Jenna e Charlie hanno trovato l'amore in Irlanda ma i loro sogni li hanno separati. Cinque anni dopo, si riuniscono e Jenna deve decidere a chi appartiene il suo cuore: a casa o sull'Isola di Smeraldo.

programme.title: La Regina degli scacchi
programme.desc: Maria Adele, 17 anni, vive per gli scacchi, ma scopre di essere stata adottata e, con l'aiuto di un giornalista, rintraccia la madre biologica. Mentre riaffiora un ricordo d'infanzia che la libera dai tormenti, emerge un'indagine che svela crimini del suo maestro di scacchi, culminati in un tragico epilogo.

programme.title: Dalle 5 Alle 7
programme.desc: Un aspirante romanziere comincia una relazione con una donna, anche se c'è solo un problema: la donna è sposata e la coppia può incontrarsi solo tra le 5 e le 7 ogni sera.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Te
programme.desc: La trentenne Daphe ha appena chiuso una relazione. A una festa incontra due uomini affascinanti e opposti: con entrambi avvia una relazione.

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!
programme.desc: Val, governante devota, vede il suo equilibrio cambiare quando la figlia Jessica arriva con le sue ambizioni. Un film vincitore al Berlinale e al Sundance che esplora temi di classe e disuguaglianza, con un'interpretazione straordinaria di Regina Casé.

programme.title: La Città invisibile
programme.desc: La terra trema e il mondo non è più lo stesso. Tutto cambia. Cambiano i paesaggi, le persone, la vita. Dalle rovine de L'Aquila nasce nuova vita. Questo è ciò che accade a Luca e Lucilla. Entrambi vittime del tragico terremoto del 6 aprile 2009, i due studenti universitari scelgono di non abbandonare la città e nemmeno i loro sogni.

programme.title: Rams
programme.desc: In una valle islandese isolata, Gummi e Kiddiley vivono fianco a fianco, badando al gregge di famiglia, considerato uno dei migliori del paese. I due fratelli vengono spesso premiati per le loro preziose pecore appartenenti a un ceppo antichissimo. Benché dividano la terra e conducano la stessa vita, Gummi e Kiddi non si parlano da quarant'anni. Quando una malattia letale colpisce il gregge di Kiddi, minacciando l'intera vallata, le autorità decidono di abbattere tutti gli animali della zona per contenere l'epidemia.

programme.title: Rosso Mille Miglia
programme.desc: Una giornalista insaziabile, un meccanico passionale, un barista inconsapevole si trovano insieme per la celebre Mille Miglia, sulla quale Maria, interpretata da Martina Stella, deve scrivere un pezzo per conto di un giornale tedesco. È l'inizio di una misteriosa avventura in cui i tre riusciranno a cucire i pezzi di una storia destinata a riportare in auge un gioiello automobilistico, il cui destino era quello di brillare. Si tratta della favolosa OM 665 S, che Maria e il meccanico Marco, a cui da volto Fabio Troiano, sperano di poter rimontare per iscriversi alla corsa "più bella del mondo". I due, andando a ritroso nel tempo si imbatteranno in un segreto ormai sepolto che farà emergere un passato tenuto nascosto.

programme.title: Surf's Up 2 Uniti Per Vincere
programme.desc: Cody Maverick, in cerca di una nuova sfida, convince un famigerato gruppo di amanti delle onde conosciuto come gli Hang 5, ad unirsi a loro nel loro viaggio verso un misterioso luogo per fare surf, conosciuto come La Trincea, dove secondo la leggenda, troveranno le più grandi onde al mondo. Cody presto scopre che la vita che si è lasciato dietro potrebbe essere più eroica di qualsiasi cosa può offrirgli un'onda in grado di sfidare la morte.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: Quando lo stregone cattivo Gargamella insegue i piccoli puffi blu fuori dal loro villaggio, dal loro mondo magico cadono nel nostro, trovandosi nel bel mezzo di Central Park a New York. I Puffi dovranno trovare il modo di ritornare al loro villaggio prima che Gargamella li catturi.

programme.title: I Puffi 2
programme.desc: Lo stregone Gargamella crea i Monelli, delle creature furbe simili ai Puffi,per impadronirsi dell'essenza magica dei Puffi. Gargamella scopre di aver bisogno dell'aiuto di Puffetta, l'unica che sa trasformare i Monelli in Puffi. Quando Gargamella e i Monelli rapiscono Puffetta dal villaggio dei Puffi e la portano a Parigi, toccherà al Grande Puffo, Tontolone, Brontolone e Vanitoso salvare Puffetta con l'aiuto dei loro amici umani Patrick e Grace Winslow!

programme.title: I Puffi: Viaggio Nella Foresta Segreta
programme.desc: In questa nuova avventura animata dei Puffi, una mappa misteriosa conduce Puffetta e i suoi migliori amici Quattrocchi, Tontolone e Forzuto a una corsa elettrizzante nella Foresta Segreta piena di creature magiche per trovare un misterioso villaggio perduto prima che ci riesca il malvagio mago Gargamella. In una rocambolesca avventura piena d'azione e pericoli, i Puffi affrontano una missione che porterà alla scoperta di uno dei più grandi segreti nella storia dei Puffi!

programme.title: Il marito in collegio
programme.desc: Carlotta sposa il benzinaio Camillo per l'eredità, ma lo manda in Svizzera per diventare raffinato.

programme.title: Il magnate
programme.desc: Clara, moglie di Furio Cicerone, rifiuta il conte Arienti, ma intrighi finanziari mettono tutto a rischio

programme.title: La pretora
programme.desc: Una pretora inflessibili affronta i ricatti dei rivali che usano la gemella pornostar, ma lei reagisce con fermezza

programme.title: Il segreto del giaguaro
programme.desc: Romano de Roma , maniaco degli anni '70, er Piotta alias "il Giaguaro" gestisce un bar a piazza Vittorio.

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
programme.desc: Un uomo cerca di bilanciare un matrimonio d'interesse con l'affetto per nonna e cane

programme.title: Fifa e arena
programme.desc: Commedia di Mario Mattoli con Totò e Isa Barzizza: per un equivoco Nicolino è scambiato per un criminale e fugge a Siviglia. Tra gag, travestimenti e corrida, combinano guai esilaranti in una Spagna tutta napoletana.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: La figlia del presidente va al college, ma i pericoli del suo titolo la seguono.

programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: Il pretore
programme.desc: Varese, anni Trenta. Il pretore Augusto Vanghetta, interpretato da Francesco Pannofino, è un uomo potente e impunito che divide la vita tra tribunale e numerose amanti. Il suo mondo dorato entra in crisi quando il giovane assistente Mario finisce per insidiare proprio la sua trascurata consorte.

programme.title: L'amore secondo Dan
programme.desc: Dan Burns (Steve Carell) è un giornalista esperto in questioni familiari. Rimasto vedovo, si è rifugiato in una rassicurante routine, in cui cerca di scansare come la peste qualsiasi novità o imprevisto, con l'arduo compito di tenere a bada tre figlie adolescenti e ribelli.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: I due pezzi da 90
programme.desc: Franco e Ciccio sono costretti ad abbandonare il loro salumificio per raggiungere il padrino di Franco: Nico Cavallaro. I due non sanno che costui è un contrabbandiere di droga e che vuole servirsi di loro per trasportare la merce.

programme.title: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Niente Di Grave, Suo Marito E Incinto
programme.desc: Marco vive a Parigi con Irene. Lei è parrucchiera, lui gestisce una scuola guida. Tutto è tranquillo finché lui non avverte strani disturbi. La diagnosi è incredibile: l'uomo è al quarto mese di gravidanza! La notizia non può che fare il giro del mondo.

programme.title: Souvenir d'italie
programme.desc: La storia di tre turiste straniere: l'inglese Margaret, la francese Josette e la tedesca Hilde che passano la frontiera con l'Italia per visitare il nostro Paese ma un incidente alla loro macchina le costringerà ad arrangiarsi con mezzi di fortuna.

programme.title: Maciste nelle miniere del re Salomone

Perfido e crudele, quest'ultimo commette a ogni tipo di nefandezze, arrivando a far arrestare il capo della città e sua figlia, Fabiola. Quando Brenno, il fidanzato di Fabiola viene condannato a morte, la città di Alesia si ribella.

programme.title: Nel Segno di Roma
programme.desc: Con Anita Ekberg e diretto anche dal grande Michelangelo Antonioni.Nell'antica Roma, guerre, alleanze e passioni si intrecciano mentre un impero lotta per imporre il proprio destino.
